facts.text: The repository's beam profiler examples cover the BC207VIS, BC210CV and BC210CU
TLBC2.py is the Python wrapper for the BC207 or BC210 beam profiler and loads the DLL for it
The upstream class takes a resource name, an identification-query flag and a reset flag and loads TLBC2_32.dll on 32-bit or TLBC2_64.dll on 64-bit Python
get_exposure_time returns a status code and writes exposure through a c_double output pointer
The exposure time is in ms, and the supported range is queried from the instrument with get_exposure_time_range
The gain is in dB, and the supported range is queried from the instrument
The precision mode values are 0 = Fast and 1 = Precise
The binning modes are 1, 2, 4, 8 and 16
The ROI is at most the full sensor size and at least 32 x 32 pixels; set_roi requires width and height multiples of 4
The sensor information reports pixel counts and the horizontal and vertical pixel pitch in um
get_image requires a 2448*2048*2 byte output buffer and reports width, height and bytes per pixel (1 in fast mode, 2 in precision mode)
request_new_measurement reads a new image and stores the calculations internally for the get_XXXX functions
The scan-data structure stores fourSigmaX and fourSigmaY as standard deviations in pixels
get_beam_width_4_sigma returns the second moment multiplied by 4 in x and y, the rotated widths, the azimuth angle and the ellipticity
get_centroid returns the centroid pixel position relative to the top left corner of the image
get_peak reports the peak intensity in digits, maximal 4096 in precision mode and 255 in fast mode
get_saturation reports ratios in the range 0.0 to 1.0
get_power returns the total power in dBm
get_temperature returns the sensor temperature in Celsius degrees
get_wavelength and set_wavelength operate in nm
close closes the instrument session and the instrument must be reinitialized to use it again
open initializes the instrument driver session: it opens a session, can query the identification, resets the instrument to a known state and sends it initialization commands
The sample adds the IVI Foundation VISA DLL directory before it loads the beam profiler DLL

estop.terminal: close() ends the TLBC2 instrument session and the instrument must be reinitialized before it is used again (TLBC2.py:229-239), and reinitializing it with open() resets the instrument and sends it initialization commands (TLBC2.py:201-208), so only a new native session on a new endpoint recovers it
